evals.prompt: Audit an API route that accepts user input, calls an external URL, and returns database records.
evals.expected_output: Produces a security audit report with OWASP category mapping, severity rationale, evidence, recommended fixes, and Completion Status.
expectations: Checks access control, SSRF, input validation, secrets, and rate limiting
Cites file/line or configuration evidence for every finding
Escalates ambiguous Critical/High findings as [P2] with advisor budget accounting
Does not include secrets or full files in snippets

evals.prompt: Threat-model this existing authenticated file-upload implementation and its trust boundaries.
evals.expected_output: Selects ywc-security-audit, not ywc-product-review, for this collision-pair request; preserves existing positive triggers and scope boundaries.

evals.prompt: Audit internal-only item 1 without audit, item 1 with audit, item 2 with audit, item 3 with independent rate limit plus audit log, and item 4 read-only by trusted authors.
evals.expected_output: Uses each severity row independently: Critical, High, Critical, Medium, High respectively. Internal-only alone never downgrades and item 2 has no downgrade.
